class_name: 話題-尊敬-ニオカレマシテハ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Marks an esteemed person as the topic where modern Japanese would use が or は: 先生にはご健勝のことと存じます. It survives mainly in set letter openings and in period fiction, so recognize it rather than produce it; におかれましては is the living equivalent. Ordinary には (location, purpose, comparison) is an unrelated everyday combination of に and は.

examples.ruby: 先生[せんせい]にはお変[か]わりなくお過[す]ごしのことと存[ぞん]じます。
examples.english: I trust that you, sir, are keeping as well as ever.

examples.ruby: 陛下[へいか]には本日[ほんじつ]ご出発[しゅっぱつ]の予定[よてい]でございます。
examples.english: His Majesty is scheduled to depart today.

examples.ruby: 殿[との]にはたいそうご機嫌[きげん]がよろしいご様子[ようす]だ。
examples.english: His lordship appears to be in exceedingly good humor.

glosses: in your case; I trust that you
patterns.usage_note: Raises a respected addressee to topic in business letters, invitations and formal notices, most often in the opening health-and-prosperity greeting: 貴社におかれましては益々ご発展のこととお慶び申し上げます. It takes a person or an organization only, not a thing, so 商品におかれましては is an error; a matter or an object takes につきましては. It is written register throughout, and archaic honorific には fills the same role in epistolary Japanese.

examples.ruby: 貴社[きしゃ]におかれましては、益々[ますます]ご発展[はってん]のこととお慶[よろこ]び申[もう]し上[あ]げます。
examples.english: We are delighted to hear of your company's continued growth.

examples.ruby: 学生[がくせい]におかれましては、履修[りしゅう]登録[とうろく]をお忘[わす]れなきようお願[ねが]いします。
examples.english: Students are kindly reminded not to forget their course registration.

examples.ruby: 各[かく]支店[してん]におかれては、在庫[ざいこ]の確認[かくにん]をお願[ねが]いします。
examples.english: Each branch is asked to check its stock on hand.
